actualPattern: ^Error: literal `[^`]*` is empty; a literal must match at least one character$
reason: A pattern that can't be constructed is GrammarError::Pattern in cpat-rs's own words, which name the pattern; v12 passes on its Literal constructor's text.
cites: DESIGN.md §18, deviations: "A pattern that can't be constructed (an empty literal, …) is GrammarError::Pattern with cpat-rs's own message"

reason: v12 looks a pattern's custom tokens up in a plain object (`customTokensMap[pattern.name] ?? []`), so a pattern named `constructor` (a literal in the TypeScript and saya grammars) finds Object.prototype.constructor and AutoComplete throws. cpat-rs keeps custom tokens in a map and suggests normally.
cites: DESIGN.md §23, "v12 bugs the harness found": custom tokens by a prototype key

expected: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
reason: Input nested past Limits::max_depth (1024 frames) halts the parse with too_deep, where v12 recurses until the JS engine overflows its stack (jq's 3000-deep paren bomb).
cites: DESIGN.md §11, deviations: "Input nested past `Limits::max_depth` halts with `too_deep`; v12 recurses until the JS engine throws `RangeError`"

expected: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'firstIndex')
reason: v12's FiniteRepeat with a trimmed divider takes "no items" for "ended on a divider" (0 % 2 === 0) when its first item fails, pops a node that isn't there and throws. cpat-rs reports the failed repeat and the choice tries its next alternative.
cites: DESIGN.md §23, "v12 bugs the harness found": a trimmed bounded repeat whose first item fails

reason: A sequence that runs out of text records its error's last index past the text's end. v12 spells that as its cursor's index + 1, and its cursor sits on the start of the last grapheme, so after a final emoji (two UTF-16 units) v12 says 16 where the text is 17 long; cpat-rs's `last` is the text's length (17). The same position, written two ways; ASCII text gives the same number in both.
cites: DESIGN.md §17, Positions ("an emoji's low surrogate there"), and §23
